target_customer: Remote and distributed teams that need quick voice, video and screen sharing collaboration
problem: Remote collaboration needed many tools. Vizy offered a click-to-talk virtual office with voice and video channels, screen sharing, multiplayer app collaboration, transcription and file sharing.
product_category: Team voice and video collaboration tool

founders.name: Sam Nickolay
founders.background_notes: YC page also lists later Patterns and Velos (GradientJ, W23).

technical_complexity.rationale: Real time voice and video with screen sharing and shared app control is standard WebRTC work with some hard parts for a three person team.

defensibility.rationale: Features were copyable and larger platforms bundled voice and video channels.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No dated source was opened; incumbents later added huddles and channels, which I could not verify with a source.

market_need_then: Remote work tooling was growing before 2020, but no dated demand evidence for Vizy specifically was found.

branding.domain_note: Used vizy.io (a .io domain). Fetch returned HTTP 503.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found and the name collides with Vizy AI camera and other Viz names.

outcome_analysis: Vizy was a three person team in YC Summer 2019 building a click-to-talk collaboration tool. One aggregator records a seed round with YC as lead in August 2019 and no amount. The company is listed inactive and one founder went on to start other companies, but no shutdown statement was found, so the cause is not public. The competition tag is a low confidence inference from crowded collaboration tools.
notes: Funding rests on Bounce Watch alone (single aggregator) and gives no amount. Competitors: only undated StackShare and Latka lists were found, which do not meet the dating rule, so the list is empty. A different Vizy (a 2012 location social network, and an AI camera) share the name and were excluded. Website returned 503.
